# Agile Counseling

> Therapy practice in Sandy, Utah, run by Candice Gonzalez, LCSW (Licensed Clinical Social Worker). Individual, child, teen and family therapy, plus EMDR for trauma. In-person at 45 W 9000 S, Ste 1, Sandy, UT 84070, and telehealth across Utah. Phone (801) 597-9558. NPI 1376050237.

## Services
- [Anxiety Therapy](https://agilecounseling.com/services/anxiety-therapy/): CBT and DBT-based care for worry, panic and social anxiety.
- [Depression Therapy](https://agilecounseling.com/services/depression-therapy/): evidence-based care for low mood and burnout.
- [Child & Teen Therapy](https://agilecounseling.com/services/child-therapy/): anxiety, ADHD, behaviour and emotional challenges, parents involved.
- [Family Counseling](https://agilecounseling.com/services/family-counseling/): communication, conflict and reconnection.
- [EMDR Therapy](https://agilecounseling.com/services/emdr-therapy/): trauma and PTSD, including a 90-minute intensive block (call for the fee).
- [LGBTQIA+ Affirming Therapy](https://agilecounseling.com/services/lgbtqia-affirming/)

- Insurance named on the site: SelectHealth, United Healthcare, BlueCross BlueShield, EMI Health, Tricare, PEHP. Confirm coverage by phone.
- Areas served: Sandy, Draper, Salt Lake City, South Jordan, West Jordan, Herriman, Murray, and telehealth statewide.
